motions.item_title: Table the September 2, 2025, Special Planning Commission Minutes and the September 9, 2025, Pla…
motions.motion: Commissioner Allen moved to table the September 2, 2025, Special Planning Commission Minutes and the September 9, 2025, Planning Commission Minutes. Commissioner Hess seconded the motion.
motions.outcome: passed with a unanimous vote of 3:0.
motions.headline: September minutes held for a later meeting
motions.summary: The commission postponed approving the minutes from its September 2 special meeting and its September 9 regular meeting.
motions.impact: The official record of those two meetings waits a little longer. Residents will not notice.

motions.item_title: Table Item 7.A., Meritage Homes Development until October 14, 2025. Commissioner Hess seconded…
motions.motion: Commissioner Allen moved to table Item 7.A., Meritage Homes Development until October 14, 2025. Commissioner Hess seconded the motion.
motions.outcome: passed with a unanimous vote of 3:0.
motions.headline: Meritage Homes development put off to October 14
motions.summary: The commission delayed a decision on the Meritage Homes development until its October 14, 2025 meeting.
motions.impact: Nothing about the project moves forward yet. Anyone following it should watch the October 14 agenda.

motions.item_title: Recommend the City Council DENY Item 7.B., Minor Site Plan for the Hidden Hollow Clubhouse Amen…
motions.motion: Commissioner Hess moved to recommend the City Council DENY Item 7.B., Minor Site Plan for the Hidden Hollow Clubhouse Amenity Swap. Commissioner Allen seconded the motion.
motions.outcome: passed with a unanimous vote of 3:0.
motions.headline: Hidden Hollow clubhouse amenity swap opposed
motions.summary: The commission recommended that the council deny a minor site plan to swap the clubhouse amenity in Hidden Hollow.
motions.impact: This is a recommendation, and the council makes the final call. The record does not say what amenity would have been swapped or why the commission opposed it.

motions.item_title: Recommend the City Council adopt a proposed Ordinance Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Cod…
motions.motion: Commissioner Allen moved to recommend the City Council adopt a proposed Ordinance Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code sections 6.05.260, 6.10.080, and creating Chapter 6.15 for establishing standards for alternative animal management plans. It also amends Tables 17.05.200(a), 17.05.200(b), and 17.05.200(c), as well as sections 17.65.050, 17.65.100, 17.70.040, 17.70.050, and 17.105.050 with the following changes: 1. Not allow ostrich/emu on quarter acre to half acre lots; and to change buffalo to bison. Commissioner Free seconded the motion.
motions.outcome: passed with a unanimous vote of 3:0.
motions.headline: New rules for keeping animals on home lots
motions.summary: The commission recommended that the council rewrite the city's animal-keeping rules, add standards for alternative animal management plans, bar ostriches and emus on quarter- to half-acre lots, and rename buffalo to bison.
motions.impact: If the council adopts this, owners of quarter- to half-acre lots could not keep ostriches or emus. Nothing changes until the council votes.
